choices.why: This pale ash Scandinavian desk has slim splayed legs and stays airy in front of the black-framed window, and at 118 cm it fits beside the glazing and matches the light floor.
The molded birch shell swivel chair on casters is ergonomic and light, and it repeats the Nordic pale wood of the desk.
This tall light-birch bookcase wall has glass doors and an open center column, holds plenty of books, and suits the long white right-hand wall in true Scandinavian library style.
The light birch bentwood rocking armchair has an off-white cushion and headrest, making it cozy for reading and in keeping with the pale woods.
The swing-arm lamp with a white drum shade reaches over the armchair to light your book, and its soft, simple Nordic look suits the corner.

answer.why: Ash and birch tie the desk, chair, bookcase and rocking chair to the light plank floor and white walls, creating a calm, bright Nordic work-and-reading corner. The off-white textiles and lamp keep it soft against the black window frame.
